upstream_release.source_revision_relation: The v1.8.0 tag ref resolved to bc1b506bdcad80bb518bf3776a9161c34ff0fc4c at the same API observation when the asset digest/size were read. This is contemporaneous GitHub metadata, not a cryptographic attestation that the asset was built from that commit.
upstream_release.immutability_note: The upstream README states every master commit is built and uploaded to the same v1.8.0 Clarke pre-release. Upstream issue #1399 documents in-place replacement of the v1.8.0 JAR. The tag and asset URL are therefore mutable; the expected digest+size guard fails closed if bytes change, but does not make the asset retrievable or immutable.
